description: Real-time updates on user's futures balances and margin information - requires authentication
send_interval: When balance or margin values change
notes: Sends updates when any futures balance or margin metrics change. Essential for monitoring margin requirements and liquidation risk.
use_case: Track futures buying power, margin levels, liquidation buffer, PnL on perpetual positions
related_channels: User channel also contains perpetual_futures_positions data
important: Critical for risk management - monitor liquidation_buffer_percentage to prevent liquidation
